facts.text: The hotel is located in the former art deco National Guard Armory in Bozeman.
facts.excerpt: Located in the former art deco National Guard Armory, this fixture of the Bozeman landscape has been intentionally revived to mirror both the culture, warmth and landscape of Montana.

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of downtown Bozeman, steps from the boutiques, restaurants and art deco buildings of Main Street.
facts.excerpt: In the heart of downtown Bozeman, Kimpton Armory Hotel is steps from the boutiques, restaurants and art deco buildings of Main Street.

facts.text: Sky Shed is a custom glass-enclosed rooftop lounge with views of four mountain ranges visible from downtown Bozeman.
facts.excerpt: head up to the roof of Kimpton Armory hotel and kick back with a drink in hand in our custom Sky Shed. Light, airy and modern, this glass-enclosed gathering place

facts.text: Tune Up is a basement-level whiskey bar with live music.
facts.excerpt: Live music reigns at Tune Up, our basement whiskey bar.

facts.text: Fielding's is the hotel's all-day ground-floor restaurant serving seasonal fare from local growers and purveyors.
facts.excerpt: Fielding's is our all-day, ground-floor restaurant serving seasonal fare from local growers and purveyors.

facts.text: Fielding's is named after Fred Fielding Wilson, architect of the original Armory building.
facts.excerpt: The namesake of Fred Fielding Wilson, architect of the original Armory building, Fielding's

facts.text: The hotel offers a Pick & Play guitar loaner program with acoustic guitars, in partnership with Gibson.
facts.excerpt: Kimpton Armory Hotel has acoustic guitars available for use while staying on property. We're partnered with Gibson and have created the Pick & Play guitar loaner program.

facts.text: Armory Music Hall is the hotel's music and event space.
facts.excerpt: Armory Music Hall is our premiere music and event space.

facts.text: The hotel has one outdoor pool, a rooftop pool overlooking the Bridger Mountain range.
facts.excerpt: roof top pool overlooking the Bridger Mountain range

facts.text: Pets are welcome at no extra charge, with no size, weight or breed limit.
facts.excerpt: We invite you to bring your pet no matter their size, weight, or breed, all at no extra charge.

facts.text: Valet parking costs 45 USD per night.
The hotel has no local area shuttle and no airport shuttle from Bozeman Yellowstone International Airport.
facts.excerpt: There is no local area shuttle available at this hotel.

facts.text: Fielding's wine program won the Wine Spectator 2026 Award of Excellence.
facts.excerpt: Wine Spectator 2026 Award of Excellence-winning wine program
